final_message:
Yen receipts now show correctly, for example `Paid ¥500 by card`. The yen receipt test passes, and so do the other 17 tests.

The cause was `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100, which is wrong for yen because yen has no minor unit. I added a zero-decimal set (just `JPY` for now) that skips the division and decimals.

`formatMoney` is shared, so invoice lines and cart totals in yen now also show whole yen. They had the same bug, and no existing test covered them. If you have other zero-decimal currencies, such as KRW, add them to that set.
